description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions used for testing npm package installation behaviors, including mocking spawn results, asserting error conditions, and verifying command executions within a Node.js/TypeScript testing environment.

classes.name: InstallResultLike
classes.description: Type representing the result of an installation attempt, indicating success with 'ok' and optional 'error' message.

classes.name: NpmPackMetadata
classes.description: Type describing metadata for an NPM package, including id, name, version, filename, integrity, and shasum.

classes.name: SpawnResult
classes.description: Type imported from '../process/exec.js' representing the result of a spawned process, with properties like code, stdout, stderr, etc.

methods.name: export function createSuccessfulSpawnResult(stdout = ""): SpawnResult { createSuccessfulSpawnResult
methods.description: Creates a mock SpawnResult object representing a successful process execution, with optional stdout content.

methods.name: export async function expectUnsupportedNpmSpec( expectUnsupportedNpmSpec
methods.description: Asserts that an npm install function correctly handles unsupported npm specifications by throwing or returning an error containing 'unsupported npm spec'.

methods.name: export function mockNpmPackMetadataResult( mockNpmPackMetadataResult
methods.description: Mocks the implementation of a command run, returning specified npm pack metadata when the 'npm pack' command is invoked.

methods.name: export function expectIntegrityDriftRejected(params: { expectIntegrityDriftRejected
methods.description: Verifies that an integrity drift detection callback is called with correct parameters and that the result indicates failure with 'integrity drift' in the error message.

methods.name: export async function expectInstallUsesIgnoreScripts(params: { expectInstallUsesIgnoreScripts
methods.description: Verifies that the install process uses the 'ignore-scripts' flag by mocking process execution and asserting the correct commands were called.
